name: Andrew Beard
strengths: Beard shows patience and vision, letting blocks develop before hitting cutback lanes with burst.
Beard runs with a low pad level and contact balance that sheds arm tackles at 5-9 / 195.
Beard creates after contact with lateral agility in the hole uncommon for his weight class.
Beard is a natural receiver out of the backfield -- screens, wheels, and option routes turn into chunk plays.
weaknesses: Beard's long speed is very good more than elite -- plus SEC pursuit can still close angles on long runs.
comparison: Beard comps to Aaron Jones -- 5-9 / ~195 creative three-down back with vision, balance, and receiving juice (size-matched to Beard's 5-9 / 195 mold).
projection: Beard projects as develop into the RB room, earn early passing-down and package snaps, then compete for a feature/RB1 role -- starter upside as a vision-first three-down back.
schemeFit: Beard fits Faulkner as a zone/gap back who also wins on screens and checkdowns.
insiderNotes: Beard shows patience and vision, letting blocks develop before hitting cutbacks with burst. Low pad level and contact balance shed arm tackles; natural receiver out of the backfield on screens, wheels, and option routes.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-05 from On3 Hudl embed. Comp size-matched within ~1-2" -- not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Andrew Beard is a 4-star RB | listed 5-9 / 195 | Prince Avenue Christian (Bogart, GA) | Florida 2027 commit.
angle: Lead with Prince Avenue junior vision, balance, and receiving upside.
